blocks.text: New York, United States—US officials gave final approval Tuesday to the Boeing 737 MAX 10, certifying the latest long-delayed version of the popular single-aisle aircraft. The Federal Aviation Administration issued a certificate confirming the largest plane in the MAX family “complies with all applicable design and safety requirements,” a Department of Transportation press release said.
